prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1205; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's all right. I was the passenger in the car.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: We were in Baytown, Texas, on a multi-lane road heading toward the interchange. My friend was driving.

Q: What was the driver doing at the time?

A: He was changing lanes to get over for the exit. He checked his mirror, I think, and then we felt a bump on the right side. The other car had come up in the lane we were moving into.

Q: Did the other vehicle make contact with your car?

A: Yes, it sideswiped us. The impact was along the passenger side, right where I was sitting. Both cars kept moving for a second before we pulled onto the shoulder.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was buckled in.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?

A: My right knee hit the door panel and the dashboard area. It hurt right away, and by the time we got out it was swollen and I could barely put weight on it.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that evening. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist for the knee.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that knee?

A: No, nothing that I can recall. I play some casual sports, but I hadn't had any problems before this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble with stairs and sitting for long periods. I'm waiting on the follow-up appointment.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
